visualCharacteristics.purpose: linked image cards with eyebrow and title overlaid on the photo
visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive grid of tall image tiles; text bottom-aligned over a dark gradient; whole card clickable

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 image; cell 2 optional eyebrow paragraph, title heading and link (the last link covers the card)

cells: Optional eyebrow, title heading, description, CTA link (or linked logo images for cards-logo-grid)

usage: More Ways to Explore style promotional tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use when the text sits on the image. For text below the image use cards-image-link.
